source_caption_text:
Drake gifts Sexyy Red a diamond-studded OVO chain at his 40th birthday party.

Drizzy hosted multiple parties over the weekend as he celebrated turning the big 4-0. On Oct. 24, he had a get-together at Delilah in New York City, which was attended by Sexyy Red, Loe Shimmy, Bow Wow and others. During the celebratory event, Aubrey presented Sexyy Red with a new OVO chain, flooded with hot pink and clear diamonds.

On Monday (Oct. 26), the St. Louis rapper shared a video on Instagram that shows her being given the piece and chain.

“It’s official Miss Champagne Mommii 🍾🎀 champagnepapi,” she captioned the post.
